tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. Warm sand in light, near-black in dark.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, forms, pricing tables sitting on surface.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and body text on surface or surface-raised (15.5:1 light, 16.2:1 dark).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, meta (6.3:1 light, 7.4:1 dark).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card borders. Decorative only, never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Rawaj orange. Logo, primary button fills, big shapes. Text on it uses ink-on-brand. Never use as small text on surface (2.9:1).

tokens.name: brand-strong
tokens.usage: Links and orange text on surface (4.6:1 light, 8.9:1 dark).

tokens.name: brand-tint
tokens.usage: Soft orange backgrounds: highlighted pricing tier, badges, callouts.

tokens.name: ink-on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand fills (5.8:1 light, 6.8:1 dark). White on orange fails contrast.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Teal for the software side: code, data, charts, secondary actions (5.2:1 light, 8.3:1 dark).

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Soft teal backgrounds for tech sections and tags.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions only. Kept small.

families.display: "Readex Pro", "IBM Plex Sans Arabic", system-ui, sans-serif

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks, badge padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on mobile, form field gaps.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between blocks inside a section.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Vertical gap between page sections.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, tags, small buttons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, buttons, pricing tiers.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Hero panels, app icon, large media.
